strengths: Canonical Racket authority is preserved and the parametric default is byte-identical to it.
Four episode-fixed settings use matched inputs, constructive distinguishing demonstrations, prefix-stable sequential public projections, and lawful 30x30 queries.
Protected-Racket evidence is source-bound by a current 13-file manifest and each setting is the unique survivor.
Both secondary repairs are narrow, regression-tested validation fixes with unchanged rule hashes.

fixed_findings.finding: The new profile-aware shortcut rival could raise while lesson_identifiable was reporting an otherwise lawful out-of-profile demonstration.
fixed_findings.resolution: Named competitor evaluation now runs only when every valid demo belongs to the linked profile set; a RED-to-GREEN regression verifies diagnostic behavior.

fixed_findings.finding: The reusable episode verifier could raise from teaching_survivors after already detecting a malformed demonstration.
fixed_findings.resolution: Unique-teaching evaluation is skipped when a demonstration input is unusable; a RED-to-GREEN regression verifies returned diagnostics.

declined_to_judge: Variant approval and training admission are maintainer decisions outside this review; the manifest explicitly leaves both false.
Unchanged broad production batteries were not run because the assignment requested focused changed-scope checks.

assessment.reason: No Critical, Important, or Minor source finding remains after the two regression-backed fixes and fresh final verification.
